claims.scope: ### W<n> weaknesses of the eic, methodology, domain and perspective seats; DA CRITICAL and MAJOR rows
claims.inventory_rule: extract with --expect-bundles 17 --expect-claims 805; build refuses an inventory whose summary has any problem, whose summary or distinct claim bundles differ from 17, whose claim count differs, or whose bundle names two fixtures

codex.settings: codex exec --json, model_reasoning_effort=xhigh, -c skills.include_instructions=false, read-only, empty working directory, prompt on stdin; a reply with any item other than a message or reasoning (a command, a file read, a tool) is a transport failure

gemini.settings: Gemini API generateContent (paid key from GEMINI_API_KEY, header only), model gemini-4-argon, thinkingLevel medium (plan v7; high in v4-v6), maxOutputTokens 32768, no tools, no system instruction, one user message holding the batch prompt, run by `dispatch_panel_claim_audit.py gemini-api-call` in an empty working directory; an error body, another model version, a finish reason other than STOP, or a part other than text is a transport failure; a call that ends with finish reason MAX_TOKENS (plan v5) or MALFORMED_RESPONSE (plan v8) is sent once more, unchanged, and a second failure stops the run

prompt_budget_rule: a first attempt is at most prompt_budget_bytes, so a retry with its note stays at most prompt_limit_bytes; agy fails silently above about 30 KB

generator.settings: agy -p, --disable-slash-commands, --output-format stream-json, empty working directory; a reply with any step other than the answer (a tool, a skill, a subagent) is a transport failure (the Google judge used the same agy settings through v3)

contrast_pairs.acceptance: build reads the pairs back from the logged generator and verifier outputs (plan transports only); a pair enters when the four mechanical checks, run again at build, and the verifier's one answer to all eight questions are true; a pair with no answer or a repeated answer is rejected; per fixture between min_accepted_per_fixture and per_fixture_requested pairs; no repeated pair id or sentence; build refuses anything else

contrast_gate.rule: per judge, with a verdict for every contrast item in every replicate (a missing one fails the gate): a false sentence is detected only when both replicates say false; an accurate sentence is flagged when either replicate says false

item_flag_rule: per judge and claim: missing when a replicate has no readable verdict; true when both replicates say false and each false passes the mechanical evidence check; false when no replicate says false; unresolved otherwise. true against not_verifiable does not change the flag

adjudication.items: every claim in an adjudicated list
adjudication.record: adjudication_decisions.json, written once by score and bound to the build manifest hash and to each claim's text hash; one verdict and one criterion id (V1-V3, R1-R5) per claim; score never overwrites it and stops on a file from another build

decision_rule.build_part_two_when: both judges pass the contrast gate, and the false-claim rate is at least 0.03 or the share of panels with a false claim is at least 0.30

stop_rules: a judge that fails the contrast gate is void; with one valid judge the run is exploratory; with none it is void
the claim inventory differs from expected_counts or has an extraction problem: stop before any judge call
fewer than min_accepted_per_fixture accepted pairs for any fixture, or any other pair problem: stop before any judge call on claims
a batch whose output cannot be read after its one retry: stop the run

a transport failure, decided from the CLI's event stream or the API response fields and never from searching its text: a nonzero exit, a failed turn or error event, no completed turn or successful result, a finish reason other than STOP, an empty reply, or any step other than the reply (a command, a file read, a tool, a skill, a subagent, a function call): stop the run, never retry, except the Gemini judge's one resend after MAX_TOKENS (v5) or MALFORMED_RESPONSE (v8)
an interrupted call (a lock without an output), or an input changed since the build: stop
no replacement model or transport without a new plan version

agreement_lists.rule: each claim falls in the first list that fits, from the flags of the valid judges only (rubric.md, Agreement)

validity.two_valid_judges: decision_relevant: the headline and the decision rule apply
validity.one_valid_judge: exploratory: per-judge counts publish, no headline rate, the decision rule does not apply

report_construction.per_item_payload: per valid judge: {item_id, is_false} for every claim with a readable verdict in both replicates, is_false true, false, or "unresolved"; a claim missing a readable verdict is left out of that judge's per_item rows and named in attempts.blocked_runs, with partial_published true (contract, Judge failure); contract divergent_items are recomputed from this payload
report_construction.headline: adjudicated false claims (agreed_false plus adjudicated items decided false) / 805; estimand_status point_estimate; resolution_direction bidirectional
report_construction.spread: raw false-verdict counts per judge per replicate, and their difference, publish beside the headline
report_construction.coverage: per judge and replicate, claims with no readable verdict; any gap is named in attempts.blocked_runs and sets partial_published true
report_construction.raw_outputs: every call's output, prompt hash, and output hash; the execution manifest from the completed calls of the generator, verifier, and judges; call_attempts.json with every logged attempt, failed and interrupted ones included

headline.false_claim_rate: adjudicated false claims / all claims, overall and by seat (seat joined after scoring from key.jsonl, which must be the file the build hashed)
headline.panels_with_false_claim: share of the 17 panels with at least one adjudicated false claim

build_binding: build copies claims.jsonl, summary.json, accepted_pairs.jsonl, and the pairs call log into the batches directory and records their hashes, the seat key hash, and the hashes of plan.json, rubric.md, PREREGISTRATION.md, prompts/, the three manuscripts, and both scripts; every later step stops on any difference

amendments.change: R4 and auditor rule 4: a claim that states a reported value or result differently from the manuscript is false; R4's not_verifiable covers only a recomputation dispute with correct inputs
amendments.reason: the v1 pilot (3 batches per judge, replicate 1): both judges rated the false contrast sentence that reverses the manuscript's stated power result not_verifiable, citing R4
amendments.v1_outputs: kept as the v1 pilot record; not scored with v2

amendments.change: the Google judge is gemini-4-argon-high (Gemini 4 Argon (High) through agy), the model the plan named before v1
amendments.reason: in the v2 pilot, gemini-3.8-flash-high answered its first batch as a long list instead of JSON Lines, exceeded its output token limit, and agy reported an error; the stop rule ended its run
amendments.v2_outputs: kept as the v2 pilot record; not scored with v3

amendments.change: the Google judge runs on the paid Gemini API (gemini-api-call helper), with a spend cap, per-call cost, and a run lock; batches rebuilt with --match-manifest against v3; v3 codex outputs reused
amendments.reason: a paid API key became available; the agy route added a skill list and a memory block to the judge's context and its quota could run out mid-run
amendments.v3_outputs: codex outputs reused unchanged (prompt, transport, and output hashes match)

amendments.change: a Gemini call that ends with MAX_TOKENS is sent once more, unchanged, under call id + -r; a second failure stops the run
amendments.reason: the v4 full run stopped at batch b005: thinking used the whole output limit and the reply was empty
amendments.v4_outputs: kept as a record; not scored

amendments.reason: b005 hit MAX_TOKENS again on its first call and its resend
amendments.v5_outputs: kept as a record; not scored

amendments.change: thinkingLevel medium; maxOutputTokens back to 32,768; judge label gemini-4-argon-medium
amendments.reason: the v6 check of b005 stopped at 32,768 tokens with CONTINUATION: a non-streaming request returns at most 32K; Google's guidance is to lower the thinking level

amendments.change: the one resend also covers finish reason MALFORMED_RESPONSE
amendments.reason: the v7 full run stopped at b078 on MALFORMED_RESPONSE, a provider-side failure with no output
amendments.v7_outputs: 77 completed batches of replicate 1, kept as a record; not scored

amendments.change: transport hardening after a security review: response and stream size ceilings, price-date check in the Gemini helper, symlink-safe side files, file-name batch ids, sanitized API error status, worst-case accounting for failed paid calls and for reported usage below a bytes-per-token floor, file-based transport input and output in a process group killed at the end of each call, at the deadline, at the stream ceiling, and on Ctrl-C (POSIX only), HTTP 200 error bodies neither forwarded nor saved, sanitized finish reasons and part keys, escaped stop messages, no paid Gemini transport for the pair steps
amendments.reason: security review of the harness before merge (three rounds and one authorized extra round)
amendments.v8_outputs: unchanged; they score under a version 9 build made with --match-manifest

amendments.change: two contrast-only judges, claude-opus-5-5 and claude-fable-5-1 through a fenced claude -p; run --contrast-only and a contrast-score command
amendments.reason: the #1002 part-two plan uses the session model as the judge only after it passes the contrast test
amendments.v8_outputs: unchanged; codex and gemini outputs and scores are not touched, and the batches are rebuilt with --match-manifest

contrast_only_judges.purpose: #1002 part two: test whether the session model, as the runtime claim-check judge, passes this plan's contrast gate; their claim verdicts are not scored and do not enter the agreement lists
contrast_only_judges.settings: claude -p --model <id> --effort high --no-session-persistence --strict-mcp-config --tools "" --disallowedTools <the dispatch_e4_panel deny list> --output-format stream-json --verbose, prompt on stdin, an empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, an allowlisted environment with the operator's OAuth token, and a new working directory outside $HOME with no CLAUDE.md, .claude, or .git in it or any folder above it, checked before the call; a tool use, an unreadable event line, or anything but exactly one successful result event is a transport failure
contrast_only_judges.batches: only the batches that hold a contrast sentence, both replicates
